caption: The drawing depicts a military-style uniform jacket shown from three angles: back, front, and side, all rendered in blue with elaborate yellow and gold trim. The back view shows yellow decorative embroidery and vertical accents on the dark blue coat, with yellow and gold trim accenting the cuffs and waistband. The front view highlights an elaborate array of closely spaced gold buttons and horizontal gold braiding across the chest, with additional yellow and gold details outlining the collar, cuffs, and sides of the jacket. The side view provides a profile that emphasizes the three-dimensional structure of the gold braiding and trim on the breast and cuff, as well as the trim running down the length of the coat. Below the jackets, there is a round button depicted in gold with an anchor and rope motif in the center. The drawing is signed “BAYARD BERNDT DEL 1956-1” in the lower right corner. The background is plain and uncolored, leaving the focus on the detailed rendering of the garments and button.
title: Coat of Naval Lieutenant
